signature_linux_initial_cold.failure_reason: Successful complete render exceeded the previous 900-second cold-build limit.

capacity_decision.rationale: The previous cold build already used 92% of its 15-minute allowance. Processed-image count grew 12.1%; the measured cold build grew 17.3%. A bounded 20-minute cold limit accommodates the expanded library with headroom while retaining the cached-build limit, quality settings, and public byte/file budgets. Both platforms use Hugo embedded Wasm codecs; there is no native-codec dependency to install.
